X input is blocked only while AreXButtonPressesDisallowed; player_spawned outside draft disallows X400ms. Menu_loaded sizes PC to HUD area and console to safe area, dispatches to children when unhandled; then focus/state restoration, close registration, postload, back-button preservation, grenade warnings and cursor disable occur in literal order. Menu selection into this MP codcaster path remains conditional; no universal HMH requirement is inferred.
